== Notes ==
* Each account is able to harvest 25 nodes per day.
* Each [[Dragonsblood weapons|Dragonsblood weapon]] costs 60 Branded Mass to craft. (50 per [[Diviner's Orichalcum-Imbued Inscription|inscription]] and 10 additional as part of the recipe.)
** A minimum of 960 Branded Mass is required to complete [[Journeyman of the Forge]].
* Each [[Heroic Dragonsblood weapons|Heroic Dragonsblood weapon]] costs 150 Branded Mass to craft. (100 to unlock the collection and 50 per inscription.)
** A minimum of 2400 Branded Mass is required to obtain all Heroic Dragonsblood weapons, after crafting the normal Dragonsblood weapons.
